exposure_classification_definitions.UNEXPOSED_REPOSITORY: No prior experimental use identified in audited repository history. Does not establish absence from LLM pretraining.
exposure_classification_definitions.EXPLORATORY_EXPOSURE: Used for preliminary experiments, debugging, diagnostics, or pilot evaluation.
exposure_classification_definitions.DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_EXPOSURE: Used to select models, chunking strategies, extractors, prompts, thresholds, or retrieval configurations.
exposure_classification_definitions.CONFIRMATORY_EVALUATION_EXPOSURE: Used in a designated confirmatory evaluation (e.g. RQ4 Test). Cannot be repurposed as a blind evaluation set for the overall pipeline.
exposure_classification_definitions.HISTORICAL_UNCERTAIN_PROVENANCE: Prior use is suspected or known from text notes, but exact item-level manifests cannot be verified.
exposure_classification_definitions.POTENTIAL_PRETRAINING_CONTAMINATION: Standard scientific caveat acknowledging that public arXiv preprints cannot be conclusively proven absent from commercial or open-source LLM pretraining corpora.
